_comment: Map raw controller inputs to actions. Action strings are listed in the README. Linux button numbers: 0=A 1=B 2=Y 3=X 4=LB 5=RB 6=LT 7=RT 8=BACK 9=START 10=GUIDE 11=L-STICK 12=R-STICK. The D-pad is the hat; the right stick is axes 3/4 (axis 2 is the LT trigger). Run with --diagnose to print the number of each button as you press it. Run --setup once to calibrate deadzone/axis_max for your controller, and --test to verify the sensitivity zones feel right.
